claim:
PR title: test(chat-lane): drain the wake queue per instant in the wake-cap test

Why: main CI failed once on 316dd73e (`wake-cap.test.ts` expected [] to equal ['check the deploy']) and passed on rerun.

Cause: a test bug, not a scheduler race. `takeDue` returns at most 50 wakes per pass (`LIMIT 50`, by design; the serve loop runs every pass). The test seeds 51 wakes an hour out, then takes one batch at `due`. The new wake's due is the next whole minute after an hour; when that fell within ~1s of the hour (about 2% of runs), all 51 seeded wakes were already due ahead of it and the single batch cut the new wake off. Time of day, not CI load, decides it.

Fix: drain each instant pass by pass. Assertions unchanged. 30 loops of the chat-lane suite pass.
